pubmed.interface: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ (same MEDLINE index also retrieved via E-utilities, no API key)

embase.interface: Embase.com Advanced Search via University of Toledo OpenAthens
embase.note: Default mapping options were on (Map to Emtree; search as free text; explode). Query #1 on results page: 959 results. Records harvested from the logged-in results session.

web_of_science.interface: Web of Science Core Collection, Topic field, editions=All
web_of_science.note: RIS export: records 1–432, Full Record. 432 unique UTs; 406 DOIs.

scopus.reason: Not licensed on University of Toledo A-Z Databases

sciencedirect.interface: ScienceDirect Advanced Search, Title/abstract/keywords (tak), via University of Toledo OpenAthens
sciencedirect.query: (dengue OR DENV) AND NS1 AND (FIA OR ELISA OR "fluorescence immunoassay" OR Platelia) AND (sensitivity OR specificity)
sciencedirect.note: Full protocol tak() string rejected (max 8 Boolean connectors per field). Condensed query: 88 hits; Research+Review filter: 75.

cochrane.interface: Cochrane Library Advanced Search, Title Abstract Keyword
cochrane.query: (dengue OR DENV OR "dengue fever") AND (NS1 OR "nonstructural protein 1") AND (FIA OR ELISA OR "fluorescence immunoassay" OR Platelia) AND (sensitivity OR specificity OR "diagnostic accuracy")

google_scholar.note: Protocol primary query with many AND-quoted blocks returned 0 hits. Focused FIA query: first 100 by relevance saved (pages 1-10).

openalex.note: Keyword search is broader than MEDLINE/Embase syntax. Do not treat 8786 as equivalent to the bibliographic database counts.

crossref.note: Not used as a PRISMA identification source. Query was too sensitive.

prisma_databases_sum_note: PubMed 423 + Embase 959 + WoS 432 + ScienceDirect 75 = 1889 before deduplication. Cochrane CENTRAL 10 is supplementary. Scholar supplementary. Scopus skipped.
